template.title: Thursday Karaoke at WesCo Brew & Bowl
template.shortDescription: Thursday karaoke at WesCo Brew & Bowl, 7:00–10:00 PM Eastern.
template.description: Come sing with Four Dogs at WesCo Brew & Bowl on Thursdays from 7:00 to 10:00 PM Eastern. Pick your favorite song, grab the mic, and bring your friends. Check the calendar for confirmed dates and holiday exceptions.
template.instructions: Karaoke runs from 7:00 to 10:00 PM Eastern. Contact WesCo for seating and participation details. Food and drinks are purchased separately.
